design_gotchas.title: CRITICAL PINOUT TRAP: Completely Incompatible With TI TPS54302/TPS54202/TPS563201/TPS562201 & AP62200!
design_gotchas.detail: Despite sharing the same 6-pin TSOT-23 / SOT-23-6 footprint, AP63300WU-7 uses 1=FB, 2=EN, 3=VIN, 4=GND, 5=SW, 6=BST — completely scrambled relative to TPS54302DDCR, TPS54202DDCR, TPS563201DDCR, TPS562201DDCR, and Diodes' own AP62200WU-7 (which all use 1=GND, 2=SW, 3=VIN, 4=FB, 5=EN, 6=BOOT/BST). Never cross-populate onto TI SOT-23-6 pads!

design_gotchas.title: Pin-Identical to AP63203WU-7 But Adjustable (0.8 V VFB), 500 kHz, and 3 A — Do NOT Tie FB to VOUT!
design_gotchas.detail: AP63300WU-7 shares the exact TSOT26 pinout of fixed 3.3 V AP63203WU-7, but AP63300 is adjustable (VFB = 0.800 V +/-1%) and runs at 500 kHz (vs 1.1 MHz). Dropping AP63300WU-7 onto an AP63203 board where FB ties directly to VOUT forces VOUT to 0.8 V; an external R1/R2 divider, C4 feedforward cap, and 4.7-6.8 uH inductor are mandatory.

design_gotchas.title: 3 A Thermal Density in Non-Exposed-Pad TSOT26 Requires 2 oz Copper and Dense Ground Vias
design_gotchas.detail: With RthetaJA = 89°C/W and no exposed thermal pad, running 3 A continuous at 24 V input generates significant package heat. Diodes Section Layout (p.19) specifically recommends 2 oz top/bottom copper, internal GND planes on 4-layer boards, and thermal vias around GND/VIN; check Fig. 38 derating above 60-85°C TA.

design_gotchas.title: PFM Light-Load Ripple & FSS Differences vs Forced-PWM Sibling AP63301WU-7
design_gotchas.detail: AP63300WU-7 (marking T6) uses PFM (22 uA Iq, up to 88% efficiency at 5 mA) plus +/-6% FSS for low EMI, at the cost of variable frequency and higher ripple at light loads. Select pin-identical AP63301WU-7 (marking T7, 280 uA Iq, no FSS) when constant 500 kHz forced-PWM ripple is required.

typical_use_cases: Industrial 12 V and 24 V distributed power bus conversion to adjustable 1.2 V-12 V rails up to 3 A
Ultra-low-Iq (22 uA) always-on 24 V IoT controllers, appliances, power tools, and home audio supplies
EMI-sensitive compact 3 A TSOT-23-6 synchronous buck leveraging ringing-free gate drive and +/-6% FSS
engineering_summary: The AP63300WU-7 is a 3.8 V to 32 V input (35 V DC / 40 V 400 ms abs max), 3 A adjustable synchronous buck converter in TSOT-23-6 (TSOT26) with 75/40 mOhm FETs, 0.800 V +/-1% VFB, 22 uA PFM Iq, 500 kHz +/-6% FSS, and a 35 V-tolerant float-to-enable EN pin (~95% peak efficiency at 12 V to 5 V). CRITICAL LAYOUT WARNING: Its pinout (1=FB, 2=EN, 3=VIN, 4=GND, 5=SW, 6=BST) matches AP63203WU-7 (requiring an external FB divider and 4.7-6.8 uH inductor vs fixed 3.3 V / 1.1 MHz AP63203) and is completely incompatible with TI SOT-23-6 bucks and AP62200WU-7; verify against the official Diodes datasheet before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.1 and p.3 confirmed TSOT26 Top View pinout (1=FB, 2=EN, 3=VIN, 4=GND, 5=SW, 6=BST) with no exposed pad — matching AP63203WU-7 and incompatible with TI SOT-23-6 bucks and AP62200WU-7.
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.2 verified Figure 1 Typical Application (5 V, L=6.8 uH, 2x22 uF Cout, R1=158k, R2=30.1k, C4=47 pF) and Figure 2 AP63300 efficiency peaking ~95% at 12 V -> 5 V.

300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.5 verified Abs Max VIN 35 V DC / 40 V 400 ms, VEN 35 V, TJ 160 C, ThetaJA 89 C/W, ThetaJC 39 C/W, Rec Op VIN 3.8-32 V, VOUT 0.8-31 V, TA -40 to 85 C, TJ -40 to 125 C.

300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.6 verified AP63300 IQ 22 uA typ (AP63301 280 uA), ISHDN 1 uA, RDS(on) 75/40 mOhm, IPEAK_LIMIT 4.5 A typ (4.1 A min), fSW 500 kHz (450-550 kHz), VFB 800 mV (792-808 mV), and tSS 4 ms.
